pages.text_en: Run, Mikey! We are late for class! The teacher is going to give us detention! Hello? Where is everybody? Maybe it is a holiday, or maybe everyone is hiding for a surprise party!

sentences.text_en: The teacher is going to give us detention!
Or maybe everyone is hiding for a surprise party?
sentences.zh: 或者大家都躲起来，准备开惊喜派对！

pages.text_en: Look outside! Zombies! That is the worst surprise party ever! The school is surrounded! We have to get to the helicopter on the roof! But we are on the first floor! We have to go up!

sentences.text_en: That is the worst surprise party ever!
sentences.zh: 这是史上最糟糕的惊喜派对了！

sentences.text_en: We have to get to the helicopter on the roof!
sentences.zh: 我们得赶到屋顶上的直升机那里！

sentences.text_en: But we are on the first floor!

pages.text_en: Look! Golden apples! These will heal us if we get bitten! Grab them! I will use this frying pan as a weapon! No snacks for you, zombie! Nice swing, JJ!

sentences.text_en: These will heal us if we get bitten!
sentences.zh: 如果我们被咬了，这些能治好我们。

sentences.text_en: I will use this frying pan as a weapon!
sentences.zh: 我要用这个平底锅当武器！

pages.text_en: We need something to clear the path! Look! The science teacher left some TNT and splash potions! I will take the TNT. Boom, boom is my specialty! I will take the healing potions! Did you know healing magic hurts zombies?

sentences.text_en: We need something to clear the path!
sentences.zh: 我们需要东西来清出一条路。

sentences.text_en: The science teacher left some TNT and splash potions!
sentences.zh: 科学老师留下了一些 TNT 和喷溅药水！
砰砰，这是我的拿手好戏！

sentences.text_en: I will take the healing potions!
Did you know healing magic hurts zombies?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，治疗魔法会伤害僵尸哦！

pages.text_en: Three doors. Only one leads to the stairs. The others are traps! Eenie, meenie, miney... I choose the middle door! Mistake! It's a spider closet! Close it, Mikey!

sentences.text_en: Only one leads to the stairs.

pages.text_en: That was close! Look at the floor, Mikey! Footprints lead to the left door! That must be the way to the roof! It's the stairs! We are almost there! Goodbye, spiders!

sentences.text_en: Footprints lead to the left door!
That must be the way to the roof!
sentences.zh: 那一定就是通往屋顶的路！

pages.text_en: The floor is gone! We have to parkour across! But I have a heavy shell! Turtle power! Jump, Mikey! I got you!

sentences.text_en: But I have a heavy shell!

pages.text_en: It's stuck! We can't break it! Stand back! It is science time! Good job, Mikey! To the roof!
No running in the halls! He has the keys! We have to fight him! Eat healthy, Principal!
I got the keys! Start the engine! Goodbye, school! Does this mean no homework? Yes, Mikey. No homework!

sentences.zh: 这是不是意味着……没有家庭作业？
